audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text described Karma's threat as generic 'CC' and called her poke 'Soulflare', an ability she does not have.
audit.why: Karma's Q is Inner Flame (950 range) and her only lane punish is Focused Resolve (W), a 675-range tether on a flat 12s cooldown at every rank that only roots if the tether is not broken by range or line of sight. That single fact is the whole difficulty.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays FAVOURED 4/10: the matchup is decided by whether you are inside 675 when Focused Resolve is cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named 'Mantra-Renewal Breath' and 'Soulflare'; Karma's Mantra bonuses are on Inner Flame, Focused Resolve and Inspire.
audit.why: Mantra is available from level 1 on a 40/38/36/34s cooldown and does not cost a skill point, so her power is continuous rather than spiking at 6. Fizz spikes at 3 (Playful/Trickster), 6 (Chum the Waters) and first item.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to real names: Seastone Trident mark at 3-5, Chum the Waters knockup through Inspire's shield at 6, first-item burst with Grievous Wounds against Mantra-Focused Resolve's self-heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction — Focused Resolve is a tether that only roots if it holds — was never stated; the page said 'his CC' and 'a held CC'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy... If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted.' Range 675, cooldown 12 flat. Playful/Trickster is a 400-range reposition on 16/14/12/10/8, so hopping outward after her cast leaves the tether range. Gathering Fire reduces Mantra's cooldown whenever her damaging abilities land, so eating Inner Flame poke accelerates her Mantra. Mantra-Focused Resolve heals her and extends the root, which is what makes Grievous Wounds matter in extended trades.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns, trading, dos/donts and early text now state the tether-break, the 675 range, the flat 12s, and the Gathering Fire/Mantra loop.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite Mantra-Focused Resolve healing her.
audit.why: Missing-interaction rule 'needs-antiheal' applies to this matchup.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds folded into the first-item spike line.

edits.before: Karma's kit is built around poke and utility, not lane-phase damage, so your all-in with Urchin Strike into Seastone Trident consistently outtrades her Soulflare pressure. She has no reliable way to punish your engage besides landing a Mantra-empowered root, which your E can dodge outright. As long as you respect her root range you snowball the lane easily.
edits.after: Karma's kit is built around poke and utility, not lane-phase damage, so Urchin Strike into Seastone Trident consistently outtrades her Inner Flame pressure. Her only real punish is Focused Resolve — a 675 tether on a flat 12s cooldown that roots only if it holds, so break it by walking or hopping out of range. Respect that range and you snowball the lane.

edits.before: Karma becomes a strong teamfight utility piece with Mantra-Renewal Breath shields and Soulflare zone control, but she still can't beat you 1v1. Pick her off in skirmishes before her team collapses, and keep denying her safe poke angles through vision control.
edits.after: Karma becomes a strong teamfight utility piece with Mantra-Inspire shields and Mantra-Inner Flame zone control, but she still can't beat you 1v1. Pick her off in skirmishes before her team collapses, and keep denying her safe poke angles through vision control.
